method: Opened actual browser-final5 PNG captures with the image viewer after the real HTTP/PostgreSQL browser run; separate from automatic layout checks and Axe.

observations.result: Readable hierarchy and wrapped source labels on mobile; dark panels and blue source actions remain distinct. Original formula crop keeps its white paper background. Self-check answer starts folded.
Failure message and three exit actions fit the narrow layout. Retry is prominent; the source action and assistant notice are visible, without replacing the preserved definition.
Viewer displays PDF page 10 of 102 with readable image, close/paging/original-file controls. Full-page capture extends below the viewport; the visible viewport uses the native modal backdrop.

Module navigation and reading column align. Definition, math, source references, self-check and next lessons have consistent spacing. Source document titles remain verbatim; UI labels use bai hoc/tai lieu.

limits: Lesson prose is scripted test content; images of document pages come from the copied real PDF via local fake media. Visual review does not establish live model quality.
